theme_stances.key_argument: Better AI economics make sustained capex easier to justify for hyperscalers.
theme_stances.evidence: AI infrastructure is becoming more heterogeneous, not simply rotating away from GPUs.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI capex is surging and on trend to outpace operating cash flow, creating digestion risks.
theme_stances.evidence: AI capex is on trend to outpace operating cash flow by end-2026

theme_stances.key_argument: We expect continued strength in AI capital expenditure to support corporate earnings growth.
theme_stances.evidence: expect continued strength in AI capital expenditure

theme_stances.key_argument: Hyperscalers are shifting from self-funding to external debt, lease, and equity structures to sustain AI capex.
theme_stances.evidence: investment levels well in excess of cash generated in operations

theme_stances.key_argument: While fundamentals are supportive, the tail risk from AI financing is too early-stage and opaque to step in.
theme_stances.evidence: the tail remains too early-stage, opaque, and sizable to step in.
